title: ProviderUnavailableError

provider.description: A key manager's provider: openbao (OpenBao or Vault), doppler, onepassword (1Password) or bitwarden (Bitwarden Secrets Manager).

connectionId.description: The existing connection, when the refusal concerns one.

details.description: What the key manager or the environment said behind the plain message, one line each, for Details: addresses, paths, HTTP statuses and system error codes. Absent when there is nothing more.

description: This environment cannot sign in to the provider: nothing was stored. data names the provider and, when an existing connection is involved, its id.
